about: Names the repository has retired, read by python -m kit stale (kit/stale.py, check names). A live page (the entry files, the indexes and every tool page) that still uses an old name needs a look: in a table row always, since a table names the thing, and in prose when the line does not also give the new name (or always, when the entry sets allow_formerly to false). Published records (docs/prereg/, docs/evidence/, docs/logs/, archives), code blocks, inline code spans and dated history lines from before the rename are left alone. Fields: old, new, since (YYYY-MM-DD), source (where the decision is recorded); optional keep (phrases, case-insensitive, where the old name is meant, such as the sentence that records the rename) and allow_formerly (default true). Entries are read in order: a line a longer old name flags is not flagged again by a shorter one listed after it. Add an entry in the same change that renames something. Scrolls-private also retires the shorter "letter reader"; this list gives only the full name for now, because public live pages still use "the letter reader" as a plain description on about 50 lines (the guide letter-reader.md, tool page titles) and the rename commit d3dc343 left those as they were.
